title: Graph Engineering durable route decision
description: Frozen 'data' payload of a RouteSelected event. It wraps the already published eight-field RouteSelectionResult without altering it, and adds the durable identity required for zero-rejudge replay.

reasonCode.description: The already published RouteSelectionReasonCode. This enum mirrors packages/primitives RouteSelectionReasonCode and python/src/graph_engineering/primitives/router.py exactly; it must not diverge.

confidenceBasisPoints.description: Explicit null when the request carried no confidence. This is the one member of the published eight-field RouteSelectionResult whose absence is represented as null rather than omission, because the field is always present in the result object.

safeId.description: A Graph IR node identifier, using the node-ID pattern from graph.schema.json. Route keys use the wider safeRouteId pattern instead, because SafeRouteId admits a leading digit while a node ID does not.

safeRouteId.description: A SafeRouteId as frozen by integrated-router-semantics.md. Unlike a node ID it may begin with a digit, and it is never '.' or '..'.
